selectionOutcomes.description: Determines how non-admin callers are restricted to files owned by the authenticated user and obtains the caller-supplied collection name.
Shows that supplying collection_name selects the branch that prepares existing file content for writing to the named collection.
Shows the call that writes the prepared documents to the caller-supplied collection and passes the authenticated user to the write helper.
Shows the post-write binding of the supplied collection name to the source file record after the write helper reports success.
Defines the caller-supplied collection_name field accepted by POST /process/file.
Uses the supplied collection name, or defaults to a file-specific collection when none is supplied.
Selects the file's existing content when a collection_name is supplied without replacement content.
Passes the caller-selected collection_name, add=True, and the authenticated user into the vector-database write operation.
On a successful write, records the selected collection_name on the source file.
